notes.title: "I Wanna Ascend" Will Become Free to Play
notes.content: [p][b]We are transitioning [i]I Wanna Ascend[/i] to a free-to-play model.[/b][/p][p] We apologize to those who have already purchased the game.[/p][p]Due to a drop in game quality and a GitHub error that resulted in the loss of all existing data, we've decided not to continue with updates. Given this situation, we felt it would be inappropriate to continue selling the game for money.[/p][p]We hope more people can enjoy the game and that it becomes a source of content for many. That's why we’ve decided to make it free.[/p][p][i]I Wanna Ascend[/i] will become free within the next 1–2 weeks. We appreciate your continued interest and support.[/p]

Get ready for a hardcore platforming challenge. Can you rise to the top?

Countless hardships and challenges await you.
Spikes, saw blades, collapsing platforms, and merciless terrain are all watching, eager to test your limits.

Dream the impossible dream, fight the unbeatable foe,
Love the unattainable, endure the unbearable pain,
And reach for the unreachable stars—I believe you can.
